summary: Tested Feedback screenshot attach/upload + Welcome Tour features (iter 57). Backend: 8/8 pytest cases pass (auth, upload validation, screenshot serving, feedback create with/without screenshot, screenshot_url path validation, admin list returns screenshot_url, admin status toggle). Frontend: Learner tour appears on first login, walks all 5 steps ('Welcome...', My Courses, Certificates, Help & guides, Feedback), final button reads 'Got it, let's go!' and finish() persists localStorage key ifpi_tour_done_v1_<userId>; reload does NOT re-show tour. Skip button on step 2 also persists the flag. Admin tour appears with 6 admin-specific steps (Welcome, Dashboard, Courses, Exams & insights, Tester feedback, Report an issue). Feedback widget: opens with title 'Report an issue', message + screenshot upload (via hidden file input) shows preview, remove works, re-attach works, submit closes panel and shows 'Feedback sent - thank you!' toast. Admin /feedback-admin renders screenshot thumbnails, image src fetch returns HTTP 200 from /api/uploads/files/feedback/. All primary happy paths pass.
critical_code_review_comments: WelcomeTour.tsx: `steps` array is recomputed on every render using live document.querySelector, which means if a step's target element disappears mid-tour the visible step could shift under the user; consider computing steps once on mount and memoizing. Not observed as a real bug in this run but is a latent flakiness source (may explain a single flaky iteration observed then not reproduced).
WelcomeTour tooltip positioning uses window.innerWidth/2 heuristic — on narrow viewports the card can clip; consider clamping within viewport bounds for both axes.

feedback.py: uploaded screenshots are stored with a per-org URL but the /screenshot endpoint does not scope key by organization_id — any authed user across orgs could theoretically request an image URL if they guess the uuid. Low risk given uuid4 unpredictability.

FeedbackWidget.tsx sets Content-Type: multipart/form-data manually — axios normally sets this with boundary automatically; forcing it may in some axios versions strip the boundary. Currently works, but safer to omit the header override.

For non-tour tests, either pre-set the flag after login and reload, or dismiss the tour by clicking skip. Backend tests are in /app/backend/tests/test_feedback_screenshot.py.
rca of the issue: N/A - no bugs found. One flaky iteration in first frontend run where final tour click seemingly did not persist was not reproducible in a re-run with slightly higher wait (600ms). Attributed to a transient re-render/timing edge; see code review comment about steps recomputation.
